name: Claranova SE
summary: Claranova SE, an international technology firm, specializes in the creation and distribution of software applications designed for a wide array of platforms, including personal computers, mobile devices, televisions, and social media networks. Its operations are structured across three distinct segments: PlanetArt, Avanquest, and myDevices. The PlanetArt division manages mobile applications like FreePrint, alongside e-commerce platforms such as Personal Creations, SimplytoImpress, CafePress, and Gifts.com. Avanquest functions as a direct-to-consumer (B2C) software publisher and distributor, delivering straightforward yet cutting-edge software solutions that facilitate everyday access to modern technology. Meanwhile, the myDevices segment provides businesses with a suite of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions aimed at streamlining asset management. Bruno Vanryb and Roger Politis co-founded the enterprise on May 28, 1984, which maintains its corporate headquarters in Neuilly-sur-Seine, France.
